name: Homosexualism
overview: Scripture calls believers to exercise righteous judgment rather than condemning others superficially or unjustly, as emphasized in John 7:24 and James 4:12. Proverbs 17:15 warns against justifying wickedness or condemning the righteous, highlighting that such actions are detestable to the Lord. In the context of homosexualism, these verses guide Christians to uphold God's standards without hypocrisy or unjust condemnation, recognizing that ultimate judgment belongs to God alone.
